intro.h2: Home restoration in Charlotte from a crew that cleans up every day
paragraphs: Copper Canyon Custom Homes is a building restoration company serving Charlotte, NC. Restoration means finding what is failing in a house and putting it right. Our Google photos show both ends of that work: rotted framing exposed behind vinyl siding, the kind of damage that gets worse when it is left alone, and a new two-car garage with a gabled covered porch.

The review we value most is about how we work, not only what we build. A homeowner says Antonio's crew came in quietly, left the place clean at the end of each work day, was easy to communicate with and showed up every day until the job was done.

services.h2: Restoration and building work in Charlotte

items.name: Wood rot and framing repair
items.blurb: Rot often hides behind siding until the damage is serious. This photo shows one wall once the siding came off: the rim board and sill had crumbled away above the foundation vent. If you notice soft trim, gaps or sagging siding near the ground, call us to take a look.

image.alt: Rotted rim board and sill exposed under lifted vinyl siding above a crawl space vent, before repair

items.name: Garages and covered porches
items.blurb: Our photos include a new two-car garage with a gabled covered porch, white board-and-batten siding, French doors and a black carriage-style garage door, taken while the last trim was still going on. Talk to us about adding a garage, porch or outbuilding to your property.

image.alt: New white board-and-batten garage with a black garage door and a gabled covered porch with French doors, near completion

items.name: Home restoration and repair
items.blurb: Restoration is how Google lists our work: bringing worn or damaged parts of a house back into sound shape. Whether it is trim, siding, framing or a tired porch, tell us what is failing and we will walk the house with you and talk through the repair.

about.text: Copper Canyon Custom Homes is a building restoration company in Charlotte, NC. Antonio leads the crew, and the customer review on our Google profile is about his team: quiet on the job, clean at the end of every day, easy to talk to and there every day until the work was finished. Our photos show both sides of what we do, from opening up rotted framing behind old siding to building a new garage with a covered porch. We read and answer our reviews ourselves, and we would like yours to say the same things.

process.h2: How a repair with us works

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (704) 993-8418 and describe what you are seeing: soft wood, damaged siding, a sagging porch or a structure you want built.

steps.title: We inspect
steps.text: We look at the problem area with you, and where damage is hidden, we explain what may need to be opened up to see it.

steps.title: Plan and price
steps.text: You get the scope of the repair and a price before work begins, so you know exactly what is being done.

steps.title: Daily work, daily cleanup
steps.text: Our crew works quietly, shows up every day until the job is done and leaves your property clean at the end of each day.

steps.title: Walk the finished job
steps.text: We walk through the repaired or new work with you, so you can see it is finished before we pack up.

service_area.text: Copper Canyon Custom Homes works with homeowners in Charlotte, NC. Google does not list a street address or a set of neighborhoods for us yet, so if your home is in or near Charlotte and you are not sure we cover it, call (704) 993-8418. Tell us where the house is and what is going on with it, and we will let you know.

items.a: For us it means repairing the parts of a house that have worn out or been damaged, such as rotted framing behind siding, and building new structures like a garage with a covered porch. Call us to describe what you are seeing, and we will tell you whether it is work we take on.

items.q: I found soft or rotten wood. What should I do?
items.a: Call us before it spreads. Rot behind siding can reach the rim board and sill, as one of our photos shows, and it is easier to deal with early. We will look at the area, explain what we find and give you a price for the repair before any work starts.

items.q: Do you build garages and porches?
items.a: Yes. Our Google photos show a new two-car garage with a gabled covered porch, white board-and-batten siding, French doors and a black garage door. If you are thinking about a garage, porch or outbuilding, call us to talk through size, layout and price.

items.q: Will my home be a mess while you work?
items.a: A homeowner who hired us says our crew came in quietly and left the place clean at the end of each work day. We know you still have to live in the house while the work is going on, and we plan each day around that.

Call (704) 993-8418 or email andrade1003@aol.com with a few photos of the problem area and a short description. We will get back to you to set up a time to look at the job and talk through what it needs.

final_cta.text: Call Copper Canyon Custom Homes and have Antonio's crew take a look.
